property_summary: After creating one address proposal and then one grant proposal, the grant details (recipient, amount) are stored at proposalCount() and the proposed address is stored at proposalCount()-1; the mutant increments proposalCount by 2 in newGrantProposal, leaving proposalCount()-1 pointing at an empty address slot.
change_summary: Change the increment from 1 to 2 so each proposal call raises proposalCount by two.
